reasons: The original text is a mutual no-hire ('agree not to hire') and its first limb reaches 'any employee of the other party' without the 'directly involved' qualifier, so the deviation call is correct: no-hire plus all-personnel scope is a walk-away trigger under NOSOLICIT.

The redline lands squarely on the stated fallback: mutual, solicitation-only ('neither party shall ... directly solicit for employment'), scoped to personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from the end of that involvement, with express carve-outs for general advertisements/non-targeted recruitment and unsolicited approaches. The 'not to hire' language is removed entirely.

The failed minimal-edit heuristic (0.757 changed ratio) is acceptable here: converting a no-hire into a scoped non-solicit and adding the carve-out sentence cannot be done with surgical word swaps, and no unnecessary changes (e.g., mutuality, governing section reference) were introduced.
The comment is accurate about what changed and why, cites the preferred position (no non-solicit binding us) while accepting the fallback, and matches the required tone and prefix.
